paragraphs: R' Ashyan son of Yakim; Yevamot, chapter 11, halakhah 7.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ד״ה א׳ פ״ח־יט is read as I Chronicles chapter 8 verse 19, without independent named-edition verification.

פ״יא ה״ז explicitly gives Yevamot chapter 11, halakhah 7; the format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but no corpus is stated or independently checked. Ashyan/Ashayin are possible transliterations of unvocalized אשיין, without identity binding; the title remains R'.
